title: "Two-way ANOVA in `R`"

All code is base `R`. Every number quoted on the Session 27 slides can be reproduced here.

## Simulated factorial: fertiliser by variety

```{r}
set.seed(2701)
r <- 4
mu <- matrix(c(20, 24, 26, 21, 30, 40), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)   # true cell means
d <- expand.grid(rep = 1:r, variety = c("V1", "V2", "V3"), fert = c("Standard", "Enriched"))
d$fert <- factor(d$fert, levels = c("Standard", "Enriched"))
d$yield <- round(mu[cbind(as.integer(d$fert), as.integer(d$variety))] + rnorm(nrow(d), 0, 2.5), 1)
with(d, tapply(yield, list(fert, variety), mean))          # cell means
with(d, interaction.plot(variety, fert, yield))
```

## The ANOVA table

```{r}
fit <- aov(yield ~ fert * variety, data = d)
summary(fit)               # F_A = 47.68, F_B = 36.95, F_AB = 8.22 on 2 and 18 df
qf(0.95, c(1, 2), 18)      # 4.41, 3.55
```

By hand: the sums of squares from the cell, row and column means.

```{r}
y <- d$yield; a <- 2; b <- 3
gm <- mean(y); mi <- tapply(y, d$fert, mean); mj <- tapply(y, d$variety, mean)
mij <- tapply(y, list(d$fert, d$variety), mean)
SSA <- b * r * sum((mi - gm)^2); SSB <- a * r * sum((mj - gm)^2)
SSAB <- r * sum((mij - outer(mi, rep(1, b)) - outer(rep(1, a), mj) + gm)^2)
SSE <- sum((y - mij[cbind(as.integer(d$fert), as.integer(d$variety))])^2)
c(SSA = SSA, SSB = SSB, SSAB = SSAB, SSE = SSE, SST = sum((y - gm)^2))
```

The additive model puts the interaction into the error:

```{r}
summary(aov(yield ~ fert + variety, data = d))
```

## Tukey

```{r}
mse <- summary(fit)[[1]][4, 3]
c(B = qtukey(0.95, 3, 18) * sqrt(mse / 8), A = qtukey(0.95, 2, 18) * sqrt(mse / 12),
  cells = qtukey(0.95, 6, 18) * sqrt(mse / 4))       # 3.63, 2.44, 6.40
TukeyHSD(fit, "variety")
TukeyHSD(fit, "fert:variety")
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2)); plot(fit, which = 1:2); par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
shapiro.test(residuals(fit))                                   # p = 0.74
bartlett.test(yield ~ interaction(fert, variety), data = d)    # p = 0.63
```

## CO2 at concentration 675

```{r}
co <- subset(CO2, conc == 675)
summary(aov(uptake ~ Type * Treatment, data = co))             # F_AB = 6.18 on 1 and 8 df
with(co, tapply(uptake, list(Type, Treatment), mean))
qf(0.95, 1, 8)                                                 # 5.32
```

## Exercise from the slides

```{r}
SS <- c(A = 120, B = 180, AB = 90); df <- c(2, 3, 6); mse <- 144 / 12
Fs <- (SS / df) / mse
rbind(F = Fs, crit = qf(0.95, df, 12), p = pf(Fs, df, 12, lower.tail = FALSE))
```
